text:
Welcome to Yen So Park, a beautiful oasis in southern Hanoi! This large green space features serene lakes and is the perfect spot for leisurely walks, delightful picnics, and various outdoor activities. Whether you’re looking to exercise, relax, or enjoy family time, this park has something for everyone.

Entry to Yen So Park is free, making it accessible for all visitors. The park is open daily from 5 AM to 7 PM, so you have plenty of time to explore its lush landscapes. However, if you plan to camp or have a barbecue, be sure to use the designated areas to ensure a pleasant experience for everyone.

For any rentals or events, please inquire on-site as additional costs may apply. Make sure to check for any specific guidelines or rental options that may enhance your visit.

Enjoy your time at Yen So Park and take in the natural beauty of Hanoi!
